page.overview:
Who is Brunok?

Brunok was a construction worker who was part of a crew on the Imperial superweapon known as the Tarkin around 3 ABY. While on the planet Hockaleg, he and another crew member were subdued by the Rebels Leia Organa, Chewbacca, and Luke Skywalker. The Rebels took the workers' uniforms so they could infiltrate the Tarkin as part of a construction crew.
